title: Divine Council
description:
The divine court in Scripture is a heavenly assembly of elohim, sons of God, under Yahweh. It is not a metaphor for human government. It is the setting in which Yahweh consults, commands, and judges lesser divine beings.

Yahweh presides, assigns the nations, holds those beings to account, and sometimes sends one of them to act on earth. The texts present a court. They do not present human judges under another name.
